confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate from general regional knowledge; no web search or live listing check was used for city prices. Restaurant and beer anchors are moderate confidence. Cocktail and wine are derived from the beer anchor (about 3.5x and 4.5x beer) because direct price knowledge is weak. Accommodation varies widely by district and property and is the least certain tier; July is a low season. FX value is from search results citing the RBA exchange-rate page (page not opened directly); two searches reported the same 15 Oct 2026 figure.
comparable_city_reasoning: Regional Southeast Asia basis: broadly in line with Phnom Penh and Luang Prabang budget-to-mid-range levels and below Bangkok tourist tiers; beer used as the reference for cocktail and wine.
